d budget

An owner or admin can cap what the whole organization spends on MCPJam-billed
work — chat, evals, judges and computer

time — for each billing period, from
**Organization → Budget**.

* Set the cap in dollars, and choose the percentages to be wa

rned at. The
 default warns at 80%; reaching the cap always notifies, whether or not you
 list it.
* Warnings go to the organ
ization's owners and admins in the notifications\n bell, and to the owner by email.\n* **When the budget is reached**, new chat t
urns, eval runs and computer starts\n are refused for the whole organization. The refusal says the budget is\n reached and that
an owner or admin can raise it — buying credits does not\n clear it. Work already in flight finishes, and running computers keep

going
 until they hibernate.
* A scheduled eval that hits the budget pauses its schedule rather than
 retrying into the same
cap every window; it resumes once you raise the cap or\n the period rolls over.\n* Runs that use **your own API keys** are never

counted against the budget and
 never blocked by it. Neither is the free daily allowance, which is not
 credits.
* The window
is your organization's own billing period: the subscription cycle\n for team and enterprise plans, and the calendar month otherw

ise. Raising or
 lowering the cap mid-period does not reset what has already been spent.

Any member can see the budget and ho
w much of it is left; only owners and\nadmins can change it. Every change is recorded in the organization's audit log\nwith who ma

de it and what it was before.

The same budget is readable and writable from the API at
`/v1/organizations/{organizationId}/spe

nd-budget`.

### Managing billing details

Organization owners on a paid plan see a **Manage billing** button on the billing p
age. Clicking it opens the Stripe portal where you can update payment methods, download invoices, add tax IDs, and review billing

details. Only organization owners can access this portal.

### Seat payment failures

When someone you invited to a paid-seat
organization signs up and the automatic seat charge fails or is cancelled, the org billing page shows a **Seat payment didn't go t
hrough** notice. As the org owner you can:\n\n* Click **Retry payment** to reopen the charge and complete payment (including any 3

DS challenge).
* Click **Remove invite** to remove the invite entirely if you no longer want to add that person.

The invited m

ember's organization appears greyed out in their sidebar until the seat is paid.
